mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Harriet Park with a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS will be visible tonight as it rises in the northwest over Verona High School and travels toward the east-northeast over the Fitchburg area, reaching about halfway up the sky. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 39 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has announced that alternate-side winter parking rules apply from November 20 through April 1 to assist with snow removal, and the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to Main Street Trick-Or-Treating and live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue who was subsequently arrested for an O W I.
Today's flavor of OREO REESE'S Cheesecake has finished for the evening. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow for Chocolate Covered Strawberry when we reopen at 10:00 AM.
